verdict.rationale: Choosing the underlying model is a fair question for an AI coding agent, but nothing in the pack shows Devin letting users pick a model or provider. The docs cover the CLI, Desktop, API, MCP, handoff and billing tiers without mentioning model or provider choice. Devin Handoff working with other agents such as Claude Code and Codex is agent interoperability, not model choice within a Devin session.
